reviews.title: Worth the money.
reviews.review: I booked my theory and got distracted with other things so studying went on the back burner. I purchased this app on Monday and my test was yesterday (on Thursday). I crammed about an hour a night and then an hour before the test. I got a 48/50 on the theory and got my certificate.I’ll be honest, I read something somewhere about the hazard test but literally didn’t know I was taking that until I completed the theory portion on the day. reviews.title: Worked for me!!
reviews.review: I used this app to study for the theory test and passed on my first try.   I’ve been a driver for 40 years in the USA and other countries but I took this test seriously.   I answered every question in all categories, rigorously reviewed every one I got wrong.   Flagged everything I needed to understand better.   I also spent the 1.99 on the hazard test videos.   Very worth it.    You should be aware that the questions you see on the actual test will not be exactly the same as the study questions

reviews.title: Great tool!
reviews.review: I have been through rigorous question practice to pass my nursing boards and this uses the same method. More questions and scenarios really gives you momentum to learn how you need to answer the question and the information is practical and sinks into to your head with this active application. I liked the immediate feedback, pass/fail bar and extra information under each question to justify answers as well. I will definitely recommend this resource to other friends who need to pass the driving e

reviews.title: So glad I studied this app!
reviews.review: After moving from the US to the UK, and having driven in the US for 30 years, I could not believe how much about English driving I didn’t know. The regulations, terminology and signs are so different. I liked this app, because it shows the correct response right away. You can go through all the questions and repeat those you miss. This tool helped me pass the Theory test the first time.

reviews.title: helped me pass - worth it
reviews.review: This is a great app! It’s really handy that it can keep track of the questions you’ve failed to pop them back up in the queue.A minor gripe: I wanted to be able to fast forward/rewind during the review of the hazard videos. Also, the hazard video section occasionally would glitch out and not let me select more videos to watch, had to close and reopen the app to make it work. Bonus: I like that it’s available in the US app store too, as I immigrated to the UK but have avoided switching to UK App

reviews.title: Best Theory Test Prep
reviews.review: Look no further than this app (and its sister app that has the UK driving regs) to study for your exam.All I did to prepare was read the UK driving regs (via the sister app) and then the quizzes (via this app). After that, I only did one practice test in the app and felt ready to go. Passed with a 94%. Saved a while bunch of time and was better prepared.

reviews.title: Super Fantastic!
reviews.review: I learn a lot better by being engaged in the learning. This app is divided by sections and you can take a random 20 question quiz where you can read in depth why the answer is. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Passes with ease
reviews.review: Great app and was spot on to the questions of the real test. If you complete the practice questions and mock test you will pass with ease.As an American knowing nothing about the driving lows and signs this app got me up to speed fast.Highly recommend

reviews.title: Great tool to help prepare!
reviews.review: I found this app was really good for studying the multiple choice questions…so handy to have (so many) them on my phone!  It definitely helped me pass my test.

reviews.title: Past my TEST
reviews.review: All you need is this app, practice the questions for a week and you will be fine. Trust.
